story_metadata.title: Hybrid Search Engine - Vector + Fulltext Search

finding.query: Orama hybrid search fulltext vector combination
finding.insight:
Orama supports both fulltext and vector search modes. The hybrid search requires combining results from both modes using a weighted scoring formula: score = (vectorWeight × vectorScore) + ((1 - vectorWeight) × fulltextScore).
Orama's search API: search(orama, { mode: 'hybrid', ... }) is NOT directly available - must implement custom hybrid scoring.
Reference: Orama.js documentation - Search Configuration

Transformers.js with CLIP model generates 384-dimensional text embeddings. The model: Xenova/clip-vit-base-patch32 is optimized for web inference.
WebGPU acceleration available when supported by browser. Fallback to WebAssembly when WebGPU not available.

Orama's internal vector search uses approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) algorithm. For hybrid search, results from both modes should be normalized to [0, 1] range before combining.
Best practice: Use cosine similarity for vector scores, BM25 for fulltext.

From implementation playbook: Recommended weights are 0.7 for vector (semantic similarity) and 0.3 for fulltext (keyword matching). This can be made configurable per search type.
Pre-normalization of scores is critical for fair combination.

pattern.name: hybrid-search-pattern
pattern.description:
Hybrid search combines vector similarity search (semantic understanding) with fulltext search (keyword matching) using weighted scoring.
Flow: 1. Receive search query 2. Generate query embedding (Transformers.js/CLIP) 3. Execute vector search → get scores (0-1) 4. Execute fulltext search → get scores (0-1) 5. Normalize both score sets 6. Combine: finalScore = (0.7 × vectorScore) + (0.3 × fulltextScore) 7. Sort by finalScore descending 8. Return top N results with source attribution

pattern.name: score-normalization
pattern.description:
Score normalization is required because: - Vector scores: cosine similarity (already 0-1) - Fulltext scores: Orama internal (needs min-max normalization)
Normalization formula: normalizedScore = (score - min) / (max - min)

pattern.name: search-result-merging
pattern.description: Results from different search modes may overlap. Merge strategy: - Create Map - For each result from vector search: add to Map - For each result from fulltext search: merge with existing or add new - Apply final scoring and sort

technical_notes.note: CRITICAL: The Orama WASM instance must be loaded before hybrid search. Check `wcStatus === 'ready'` and ensure embeddings model is initialized.
Weight configuration: Vector weight = 0.7, Fulltext weight = 0.3. These should be configurable via search options but default to these values.
Performance: Run vector and fulltext searches in parallel using Promise.all() to minimize latency. The embedding generation is the bottleneck.
Source attribution: Each search result must include the documentId and original content excerpt for citation in responses.
Debouncing: Client-side search queries should be debounced (300-500ms) to avoid excessive embedding generation and search operations.
Error handling: If vector search fails (e.g., embedding model not ready), fall back to fulltext-only search with appropriate user feedback.

acceptance_criteria.ac: Given: Orama index with embedded documents exists When: hybridSearch(query) is called Then: Both vector and fulltext searches execute in parallel
Given: Search results from both modes When: Scores are combined Then: Final score = (0.7 × vectorScore) + (0.3 × fulltextScore)
Given: Multiple documents match query When: Results are sorted Then: Results ordered by combined score descending
Given: Search completes When: Results are returned Then: Each result includes documentId, content excerpt, and source metadata
Given: Search is configured with custom weights When: hybridSearch is called with options Then: Custom weights override default (0.7/0.3)
